runnerManager.testTitle: End-to-end: create a user, verify it in the Users list, edit it, then delete it
runnerManager.testDescription: Verify the full user lifecycle — create a user with all fields, confirm it is listed, open it for edit, then delete it and confirm it is gone.

runnerManager.testTitle: Create a user with all fields populated
runnerManager.testDescription: Verify that an administrator user can be created with all fields populated and appears in the Users list.

runnerManager.testTitle: Create a user with only the required fields
runnerManager.testDescription: Verify that a user can be created with only the required fields.

runnerManager.testTitle: Every Role option is offered in the documented order
runnerManager.testDescription: Verify that the Role dropdown offers exactly the 17 documented options, in the documented order, each one selectable. A guard against an option being added, removed or reordered.

runnerManager.testTitle: Creating a user with an Initials value already in use is rejected
runnerManager.testDescription: Verify that creating a user with an Initials value already in use is rejected.

runnerManager.testTitle: Create a user with a non-administrator role
runnerManager.testDescription: Verify that a user can be created with a role other than Administrator and appears in the Users list.

runnerManager.testTitle: Ranch, field, crop, and variety setup
runnerManager.testDescription: Build the ranch and field location hierarchy that field capture, pay, and reporting hang off, along with the crop and variety records jobs reference. Every setup record carries a database-unique barcode and an accounting export identifier.

runnerManager.testTitle: Job setup and earning codes
runnerManager.testDescription: Define each job's payment type, rates, overtime rule, and the earning codes the payroll export depends on. Payment type drives which fields are active and how the job pays.

runnerManager.testTitle: Crew setup
runnerManager.testDescription: Define each crew with its department, supervisor, badge color, defaults, and the auto-break, exercise, and notification behavior that shapes capture and pay. Crew-level settings override global preferences.

runnerManager.testTitle: Employee setup
runnerManager.testDescription: Create each employee with identity, badges, home crew, pay, meal waivers, and compliance data; the employee record is the most linked record in the system and the anchor for traceability. The record itself is core, while specific compliance fields unlock with their modules.

runnerManager.testTitle: Gather Logs command returns a per-device run reaching terminal status
runnerManager.testDescription: Tier 1 contract: POST connectivity/device-command/gather-logs is permission-gated and CSRF-guarded, returns the per-device run envelope, persists a DeviceCommandRun and polls to a terminal status. A 400 no-eligible-devices outcome is contract-valid; 401/403/5xx are not.

runnerManager.testTitle: Request Partial Data command returns a per-device run reaching terminal status
runnerManager.testDescription: Tier 1 contract: POST connectivity/device-command/request-partial-data with a valid date range behaves as above — per-device run envelope, persisted run, terminal poll.

runnerManager.testTitle: Set Timezone command returns a per-device run reaching terminal status
runnerManager.testDescription: Tier 1 contract: POST connectivity/device-command/set-timezone behaves as above, and short-circuits with skipped=true plus an empty device list when no biometric-kiosk devices exist.

runnerManager.testTitle: Web per-device result and log output matches legacy for the same device set
runnerManager.testDescription: Tier 2 parity, host-bound: the web per-device result/log output — device set, per-device statuses, one file per device and MessageType.Single — matches the legacy baseline for the same devices. Needs PET_DEVICE_CMD_EQUIV=1, live send and a baseline file that only exists on the windows-automation host.

runnerManager.testTitle: Scan device registration and data scoping
runnerManager.testDescription: Create the device record, set its type and login, push setup to it, and scope which crews, employees, fields, and jobs it receives.

runnerManager.testTitle: GPS field boundary mapping
runnerManager.testDescription: Draw each field's boundary so it displays on maps and dashboards and so the captured area and a GPS stamp are available. Mapping is a separately licensed module.

runnerManager.testTitle: Piece-out and sticker-roll configuration
runnerManager.testDescription: Configure the office-side settings that make field piece capture work: the piece method (sticker roll versus badge) and the piece-out preferences that bound each scan. The day-start sticker-roll assignment itself is a field action (see B4).

runnerManager.testTitle: Overtime, compliance, and penalty rule setup
runnerManager.testDescription: Configure the overtime rules and the meal and break penalty rule that drive compliant pay, selected from templates during the setup interview.

runnerManager.testTitle: Preferences configuration
runnerManager.testDescription: Set the program preferences that govern capture and calculation, including decimal precision and the accounting export format; these are deep, precedence-ordered settings best left support-gated.

runnerManager.testTitle: Equipment setup
runnerManager.testDescription: Register equipment for cost accounting, contractor billing, and hours-of-use tracking; this is asset tracking, not payroll.

runnerManager.testTitle: Employee onboarding forms configuration
runnerManager.testDescription: Configure the government and company forms employees complete and sign at hire, and the form sets that apply per situation. Included for catalog completeness; parked for Anthony.

runnerManager.testTitle: Device interface and behavior configuration
runnerManager.testDescription: Tune what a device shows and how it behaves: button labels via alias sets, device preferences, and the clock-out questions that route to a notification user.
